name: Design Evidence Backed Offer
summary: Design an offer whose value, scope, proof, risk allocation, and terms can withstand review.
description: Design or review a commercial offer by aligning a real customer outcome with scope, delivery mechanism, proof, price structure, risk allocation, capacity, and clear terms. Use when packaging a service, course, productized engagement, or high-consideration sale.
risk_reason: This skill designs an offer whose value, scope, proof, risk allocation, and terms can withstand review; it does not recommend an offer the organization cannot fulfill consistently.
refuses: It does not fabricate bonuses, reference prices, guarantees, scarcity, testimonials, or expected outcomes.
It does not hide recurring charges, exclusions, cancellation conditions, or material delivery dependencies.
It does not recommend an offer the organization cannot fulfill consistently.

operational.latency_reason: The skill designs an offer whose value, scope, proof, risk allocation, and terms can withstand review, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
